version: plan v4 round 5 (round 4 + nod:dash 2:1 objective, 8 nod ES cases, 128-case selection)
written_before: any round-5 search, selection or blind test; no learned controller has been run on the round-5 nod/dash blind set
decided_by: the user (2026-10-17 JST): all three changes of the round-5 draft
architecture: identical to round 4 (descend_r4.RefractoryLearned: gated layer, 20 inputs, refractory 37 ms while in charge, righting reflex 25 deg, law_tuned / pulse_tuned)

changes_vs_round4.objective_weights: ES and selection objective nod 2/3, dash 1/3 (round 4: 1/2, 1/2); per-task term unchanged: mean ratio + mean max(0, tilt_peak - 60) * 0.3
changes_vs_round4.nod_cases: 8 nod + 4 dash cases per ES candidate per generation (round 4: 4 + 4); same training generator, ES offsets 100_000 + gen*100
changes_vs_round4.selection: reselect_r3 rule via descend_r5 on claude-ea with 64 nod + 64 dash validation cases (round 4: 8 + 8): lowest penalised (2:1) composite among centres with zero crashes and tilt peak < 70 deg on all 128; fallbacks reported

evidence.arithmetic: hover 1.000 and upset 1.050 by construction -> H1 needs (nod + dash)/2 <= 0.848; dash alone is ~0.84 -> the nod decides
evidence.head_to_head: plan_v4/r4/compare_rounds_final: same 128 training cases, crash rate r2 1.0 %, r3 1.0 %, r4 0.6 %; flown-only nod 0.906 / 0.940 / 0.939, dash 0.850 / 0.870 / 0.830

wide_selection.note: every round-4 centre re-validated on 128 training cases: 4 of 5 16-case picks crash 1-3 times; crash counts grow with the generation; the 128-case picks fly the round-4 blind set with 0 crashes but only seed 1 reaches <= 0.95 (nod 0.87-1.05): selection fixes the crashes, not the nod

training.method: descend.py finetune via descend_r5 (OpenAI-ES, pop 32, sigma .03, Adam .02), 60 generations, --hours 24 wall-clock cap only
training.start: round-2 gated imitation spec of the same seed with refractory_s 0.037 (byte-identical to plan_v4/r4/train/imitate_spec_s*.json), seeds 1-5
training.machines: searches: claude-ea seeds 1, 2, 3 (10 workers each), HomePC seed 4 (18 workers), LabHPPC seed 5 (14 workers; same-seed search identical to HomePC for 45 generations in round 4, amendment 1); every selection and blind test on claude-ea

test_sets.nod_dash: fresh blind set, maneuver_v2 base 2_096_600_000 (16 cases per task; never used before)
test_sets.normaliser_rule: nod/dash opponent per-case median on the fresh blind set (learned side: mean incl. crashes); hover/upset opponent mean (unchanged sets, claude-ea rows)
test_sets.secondary_normalisation: opponent mean on the same claude-ea rows

hypotheses.H1: blind composite (25/25/25/25) <= 0.95 (strict, unrounded) AND T1 ratio <= 1.05, in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.H1_prime: every task ratio <= 1.05 (strict, unrounded; the upset ratio 1.0502 of the gated design fails this, reported both ways) AND at least one of T2/T3 <= 0.90 with paired sign-test p < 0.05, in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.H2: >= 2 of T2, T3, T4 <= 0.90 in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.H3: ablations (clamp_fast, nodelay_all, noref, nopulse) raise the composite by >= 10 % or silence the pulses
hypotheses.H5: 0 crashes in the 32 nod+dash blind episodes, in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.secondary: per-case median ratio, paired wins, crash type, onsets / cancelled onsets; crash rate of the selected centres on the 128 selection cases
